description: This file contains implementation of a remote commit service interface and its classes for simulating transaction operations (pass, fail, throw). It includes classes for each operation that implement commit logic via an external service, plus the service class itself.

classes.name: IRemoteCommitService
classes.description: Interface defining commit operations with methods to pass, fail, or throw for a transaction.

classes.name: RemoteCommitService
classes.description: Implementation of the remote commit service that logs and simulates transaction outcomes.

classes.name: ThrowOperation
classes.description: Represents an operation that throws an exception during commit.

methods.name: Throw
methods.description: Simulates an exception during transaction commit.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Executes the specific commit operation using the provided service.
